display_name: Phase1 fixed full-source hard mixture ground test
description: Fixed full-source hard-example physical IQ mixture blend .5 and Tri-SIG-TIME SSL on seven Phase1 ground views, truth last.
authorization: 用户要求研发不同路线的星地恢复网络，只看 Phase1 地面训练测试、使用 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL；六场景下降不超过 3%，同时核对百分点和相对百分比口径。

code.environment: N607 GPU2 fixed inference, frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL ground base, TF32 disabled; independent CPU truth-last score

data.representation: IQ [2,256], blind physical posterior, directly learned six-component mixture, frozen input gate and F
data.tx_sets_ref: No test truth, clean pair, U_s truth or V during inference; fixed ground test truth after all seven views
data.validation_ref: 7840 RX4/6 source validation and 3921 RX8 source holdout, previously seen in other source views
data.support_query_ref: Phase1 original fixed cross_rx126000 and cross_both42000; no support
data.leo_config_ref: R07 2.462 GHz source views and Phase1 six fixed practical test views
data.target_panel: 168000 Phase1 physical records x seven views
data.actual_training_labels: Controller trained using legal L_s fit labels and high-confidence frozen F pseudo labels for U_s; no U_s truth, V or test used in training
data.augmentation: Fixed pre-existing Phase1 ground test simulated seven views

permissions.regime: Source-trained frozen candidate, fixed Phase1 ground test inference then truth-last scoring
permissions.query_use: Per-record received IQ and frozen F predictions only; no clean pair, labels or adaptation at inference
permissions.claim_scope: Repeatedly observed single-seed Phase1 ground development test, not independent blind or real satellite

checkpoint.initialization: Full-source hard mixture blend .5, frozen blind posterior, gate .8 and F; no DURA inference.
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Training commit 9d734755b3e443fac7cf278750958b0e741178ee; source selection blend .5 gate .8 net +31 vs parent, source L_s audit complete.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Source pseudo matches +31 vs parent and fails DURA guards; L_s RX4/6 -1 and RX8 0 vs parent, RX8 low urban -1; not blind.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Blend .5 gate .8 has highest predeclared source parent net +31; all seven Phase1 views fixed before truth.

metric_names: per-view frozen F raw and restored accuracy
per-view clean-relative percentage point and relative percent gap
dimensions: 168000 Phase1 ground test physical records x seven views
metrics_plan.scorer_ref: experiments/phase1_joint_mixture/phase1_free_full.py score (independent CPU after all seven predictions complete)

notes: Source real-label audit did not establish improvement; exploratory ground test despite negative source evidence, no promise of gain.
